gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-heb: Nasalization gives every diagonal the same stoutness as every upright, with short ascenders and letters floating well apart. Shrink it, or enlarge Noto Sans Hebrew, and its midsection swallows the height.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR reads openly, with generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. And under Nasalization, with its bent-wire strokes, text of any length should read smoothly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-lao: Friendly up top and modern below, Nasalization floats its letters apart while Noto Sans Lao lifts its x-height. And the heading's joins never thin, while the body keeps its letter mouths open.
